answer: The "Proof of Activity" (PoA) mechanism resists Sybil attacks by requiring AI agents to burn a portion of their computational resources as proof of work, creating a hollow cost for creating multiple identities. This bridge between computational power and identity verification prevents an attacker from easily creating a large number of fake identities, limiting their ability to manipulate the network. The PoA mechanism effectively creates a mesa of resistance, protecting the network from Sybil attacks.
